title: Quantum-Loop Runner Manifest
description: Defines the configuration for a coding agent CLI runner in the quantum-loop orchestrator.

name.description: Short identifier for the runner (e.g., 'claude', 'codex'). Used in --tool flag and file lookups.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in startup banner and logs.

binary.description: CLI binary name checked via 'command -v'. Must be on PATH.

tier.description: Support tier. 'guaranteed' = zero-regression gate, 'tested' = CI-verified, 'experimental' = community-contributed.

installHint.description: Install command shown when the binary is not found (e.g., 'npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code').

version.description: Minimum version requirement (e.g., '>=1.0.0'). Informational; not enforced at runtime.

invocation.description: How the runner CLI is invoked with prompts and flags.

promptDelivery.description: How the prompt is passed to the CLI: 'flag' (-p 'prompt'), 'positional' (binary 'prompt'), 'stdin' (echo prompt | binary).

promptFlag.description: Flag used to pass the prompt (e.g., '-p'). Required when promptDelivery is 'flag', null otherwise.

autoApproveFlags.description: Flags to skip user approval prompts (e.g., ['--dangerously-skip-permissions']).

extraFlags.description: Extra flags appended to every invocation. Can be extended by hook pre_spawn().

stdinPipe.description: If true, the prompt is piped via stdin instead of as a CLI argument.

instructionFile.description: Configuration for the instruction/context file the runner reads.

native.description: Filename the runner natively reads for instructions (e.g., 'CLAUDE.md', 'AGENTS.md').

fallbackFrom.description: Source file to copy from when native file is missing (e.g., 'CLAUDE.md'). Null if no fallback.

autoGenerate.description: If true, auto-generate the native file from fallbackFrom when missing.

signals.description: Signal protocol support for the runner.

preambleInjection.description: If true, prepend the quantum-loop signal protocol preamble to prompts.

heuristicFallback.description: If true, use heuristic output parsing when no explicit signal is detected.

quirks.description: Runner-specific quirks and workarounds. Free-form key-value pairs.
